verdict.rationale: First-party docs say self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your own infrastructure, including your own browsers and your own LLM API keys. The product is open-source, which means it can run without a Skyvern cloud account. The cloud Chromium connection described for the SDK applies to the hosted mode and does not contradict the self-hosted path. Missing for 10: an explicit local-machine development quickstart (e.g., attaching to a local Chrome instance), confirmation that the SDK works without cloud credentials, and hands-on corroboration of a local setup.
